prompt: Minimalist sci-fi cinematic, one continuous shot in a pure black void. The only environment is a thin glowing cyan-blue wireframe perspective grid floor receding to infinity — 3D space rendered in a clean 2D vector style. No people, no text, nothing else. An angular white wireframe dart (the attacker) hovers low on the left. Far down the grid a red wireframe octahedron (the enemy) hovers, pulsing with a faint menacing red core. First act, the pregnant charge: a luminous blue energy sphere builds at the attacker's tip — glowing particles spiral inward, the orb swells and pulses with an accelerating heartbeat, its blue light pooling on the grid — then a pregnant pause, everything dead still, the orb contracts, near silence. Second act, the shot: the sphere FIRES with a muzzle flash and recoil; the camera whips around behind it and races low over the grid at extreme speed, grid lines streaking past with intense parallax, a comet trail of blue light, the red octahedron rushing closer from a distant speck. Final act, the payoff: extreme slow motion at the moment of impact seen from a side profile — the blue sphere squashes against the octahedron, cracks of white light spread across its faces, shockwave rings expand, sparks hang frozen mid-air — then time snaps back to full speed, the octahedron shatters into glowing wireframe fragments, a shockwave ripples through the grid floor, camera shake, debris drifting as it fades to black. Audio: rising charge hum with accelerating heartbeat, dead silence in the pause, thunderous launch boom into a rushing whoosh, deep rumble during slow motion, massive glassy shatter at impact, echoing tail.
